rule: A row-1 header cell in column C or beyond IS an account header when its words (case-folded, split on whitespace, hyphen and slash, each stripped of punctuation) are: (a) either 'no. of' then a NON-plural account word, or the two-word modifier 'roth ira', or one modifier (custodian, client, sub, brokerage, ira, joint, trust); then (b) an account word (account, accounts, acct, accts, acc, accnt, subaccount, subaccounts); then nothing, or identifier words only (number, numb, num, nbr, no, id, ref, reference, code, key, identifier, seq, sequence, numbers, nos, seqno, serial). A whole-cell exclusion list (r17 attribute forms; the COUNT exclusion no. of + plural account word) is applied first.
backstop: AR-y-194 VALUE BACKSTOP. A non-matched header that carries an account ROOT word (acc, acct, accnt, subacc), or is the count header 'No. of Accounts' (no. of + plural), is read as an account column when its column holds TWO OR MORE DISTINCT identifier-like values in the rows below it. The finding keeps the code ACCOUNT_COLUMN_SEVERAL_VALUES and its words (ACCOUNT_VALUE_BACKSTOP) say what is seen and ask; they never say split.
identifier_like_definition: A value is identifier-like when (1) it is one token of 4 to 40 characters drawn from ASCII letters, digits, hyphen and underscore (no space, no other punctuation); (2) it is not a date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD, compact YYYYMMDD, day-month-year with a three-letter or full month name, year-month name day); and (3) it holds a letter AND a digit together, or it is a run of 8 or more digits. Excluded by the definition: a name (no digit), a status word (no digit), a money value (a dollar sign, a comma or a point), a date, and a run of fewer than 8 digits (a quantity or a count).
count_header_rule: 'No. of Accounts' stays excluded from the header rule (AR-y-181). The backstop reads it as an account column only when its values are identifier-like; counts (one small integer per row) are not identifier-like and it is not turned back. Values that are neither counts nor identifiers (names) are also not turned back, so the r18 test test_no_of_accounts_is_a_count_not_an_account_column (names ACCT-ONE, ACCT-TWO) holds unchanged.

widened_additions.trust (modifier): Trust Account names the account a trust holds, the same as Brokerage Account.
widened_additions.roth ira (two-word modifier): Roth IRA Account names the account; ira alone already matches IRA Account, so the pair is the same account with its wrapper word in front.
widened_additions.numbers, nos, seqno, serial (identifier: Account Numbers, Account Nos, Account Seqno, Account Serial number the account within the file, as number and no already do.
widened_additions.accnt (account word): the spelling of acct; Accnt names an account.
widened_additions.subaccounts (account word): the plural of subaccount; the same account as Subaccount. r18 declined it (no census form carried it); the r19 population carries it.

census.grid: The r18 grid (prefixes x account spellings x tail words), extended with the prefix roth ira: 11 prefixes x 10 spellings x 22 tails = 2420 headers; 2420 distinct.
